title: How to choose the right hoodie size
excerpt: Most returns we get are hoodies that fit a size off. Here is how to get it right first time.
content:
Most returns we get are hoodies that fit a size off. Here is how to get it right first time.

Measure one you love

Lay your favourite hoodie flat. Measure armpit to armpit, and from the top of the shoulder to the hem. Compare those two numbers with the size guide.

Think about how you wear it

Over a t-shirt only: take your normal size. Over a shirt or a thin jumper: go up one. If you are between sizes, our fleece softens and gives a little after a few washes.

title: How to wash fleece so it stays soft
excerpt: Fleece hates heat. Keep it away from hot washes and tumble dryers and it will last for years.
content:
Fleece hates heat. Keep it away from hot washes and tumble dryers and it will last for years.

  • Turn it inside out
  • Wash at 30°C with similar colours
  • Skip the fabric softener; it flattens the fibres
  • Dry flat or on a hanger, away from the radiator

If it pills, a cheap fabric shaver takes it right back. And if a seam goes in the first year, send it to us and we will fix it.

title: The capsule wardrobe, our way
excerpt: A capsule wardrobe does not have to be beige. Ours is fifteen pieces that all go together: two hoodies, three t-shirts, one jacket, two pairs of jeans, a pair of shorts, a cap, and a few things just for fun.
content:
A capsule wardrobe does not have to be beige. Ours is fifteen pieces that all go together: two hoodies, three t-shirts, one jacket, two pairs of jeans, a pair of shorts, a cap, and a few things just for fun.

Start with what you already wear every week. Replace things only when they wear out, with something that goes with the rest.

title: Layering for the cold months
excerpt: A thin base, a warm middle and a jacket that blocks the wind. That is the whole trick.
content:
A thin base, a warm middle and a jacket that blocks the wind. That is the whole trick.

  • Base: a cotton tee, close but not tight
  • Middle: a fleece or a hoodie, the warm part
  • Top: a jacket that keeps the wind and drizzle out

Take the middle off indoors and you are not too hot on the bus.
